findings.summary: Services reach into private AgentOrchestrator fields instead of a public dispatch API
evidence: TaskDispatchService reads _task_graphs, _base_state and calls run_workflow with private compiled graphs
ProducerService reads _base_state and calls _run_producer()
findings.suggestion: Expose a narrow public facade on AgentOrchestrator (get_task_graph, base_state, run_producer) or inject compiled graphs and base state into services at construction.

findings.summary: MainWindow calls AgentOrchestrator directly, bypassing QtCommandBridge
evidence: MainWindow invokes start_event_driven, submit_human_review, signal_stop, and update_provider on the orchestrator directly
QtCommandBridge exposes commands/events but no orchestrator lifecycle surface
findings.suggestion: Route workflow start/stop, human review, and provider updates through QtCommandBridge commands so UI never holds direct orchestrator references.

findings.summary: Project task model imports AgentRole while runtime dicts use different field names
evidence: AgentTask TypedDict declares type: AgentRole and status: TaskStatus
ProjectManager and assign_task tool use task_type and state string keys instead
findings.suggestion: Define a project-layer PersistedTask TypedDict with task_type/state in project/tasks.py without agent imports; map to AgentRole only in the agents package.

findings.summary: Agent file tools bypass FileManager for read/list while AGENTS.md mandates FileManager for all file access
evidence: create_file delegates to FileManager but read_file and list_files use Path directly
FileManager stores EventHandler but never emits PROJECT_FILE_* events
findings.suggestion: Add FileManager.read_project_file and list_project_files that emit PROJECT_FILE_* events; route all agent tools through them.

findings.summary: Polling graph task_dispatcher and event-driven TaskDispatchService overlap in production wiring
evidence: app.py builds full WorkflowSpec with task_dispatcher while subscribing TaskDispatchService to TASK_CREATED
MainWindow uses start_event_driven, not run_polling_workflow
findings.suggestion: Choose one dispatch model for production: drop task_dispatcher from the default spec when event-driven services are active, or remove TaskDispatchService and drive dispatch solely through the graph.

findings.summary: AgentMessage reset dicts are copy-pasted across UI, orchestrator, and services
evidence: Near-identical partial AgentMessage literals appear in main_window, start_event_driven seed, TaskDispatchService, ProducerService, and polling reset
findings.suggestion: Add create_initial_state, reset_for_producer, and reset_for_task helpers in state.py and replace inline dict literals.

findings.summary: AgentOrchestrator combines graph compilation, human review, polling, and lifecycle in one class
evidence: human_review_node, run_workflow interrupt loop, start_event_driven, and run_polling_workflow all live in orchestrator.py (~500 LOC)
findings.suggestion: Extract HumanReviewCoordinator, WorkflowRunner, and GraphRegistry from AgentOrchestrator; keep orchestrator as a thin lifecycle coordinator.

findings.summary: KanbanBoard hardcodes tasks.json instead of FileManager.TASKS_FILE
evidence: kanban_board.py uses literal tasks.json while FileManager defines TASKS_FILE constant
findings.suggestion: Import and use FileManager.TASKS_FILE for all task persistence paths.

findings.summary: app.py imports private _create_* tool factories from llm.tools
evidence: app.py imports _create_assign_task_tool, _create_file_tool, and other underscore-prefixed factories
findings.suggestion: Expose a public build_agent_tools(...) factory and import that from app.py instead of private helpers.

findings.summary: Agent tool callbacks return three different error result shapes
evidence: File tools return plain strings on validation failure
assign_task returns {no_more_tasks, error} while set_direction returns {direction, message}
findings.suggestion: Standardize tool failures to a single contract such as {ok: false, error: ...} across all callbacks.

findings.summary: CreateProjectCommand handler ignores FileManager.create_project_structure bool return
evidence: handle_create_project calls create_project_structure without checking its return value
findings.suggestion: Check the return value and propagate failure to CommandBus/UI when project creation fails.

findings.summary: get_workflow_state swallows all exceptions and returns None without logging
evidence: get_workflow_state uses except Exception: return None with no log line
findings.suggestion: Log at warning level before returning None, or re-raise unexpected errors after logging.

findings.summary: TaskCreationDialog agent and task_type combos are never populated
evidence: TaskCreationDialog creates agent_combo and task_type_combo but never calls addItems
get_task_data reads currentText from empty combos yielding blank values
findings.suggestion: Populate combos from orchestrator agent names and valid task types when opening the dialog.

findings.summary: Kanban state-to-column routing logic is duplicated in add_task and refresh_board
evidence: Identical state-to-column if/elif blocks appear in add_task and refresh_board
findings.suggestion: Extract _column_for_state(state) helper and reuse in both code paths.

findings.summary: LangChainAdapter is a partial shim rather than a LangChain BaseChatModel
evidence: Adapter exposes invoke/ainvoke but does not subclass langchain_core chat model types
Tool binding duplicates StructuredTool plus parallel _agent_tool_schemas map
findings.suggestion: Either subclass BaseChatModel properly or rename/document LangChainAdapter as an internal Agent runtime adapter to avoid false LangChain compatibility expectations.

findings.summary: pytest and pytest-asyncio are listed as runtime project dependencies
evidence: pytest>=9.0.2 and pytest-asyncio>=0.25.2 appear under [project] dependencies, not dev/optional groups
findings.suggestion: Move test dependencies to [dependency-groups] dev or [project.optional-dependencies] test.

findings.summary: Top-level langchain package is declared but only langchain_core is imported in src
evidence: pyproject.toml lists langchain>=1.2.10 while src imports use langchain_core only
findings.suggestion: Remove unused langchain dependency or document and use it; keep langchain_core as the direct dependency.

findings.summary: Primary UI workflow in MainWindow has no dedicated test module
evidence: 41 src files vs 17 test files; no test_main_window.py despite 600 LOC workflow thread and human review wiring
findings.suggestion: Add integration tests for WorkflowThread startup, stop signal, and human review submission using QApplication fixture and mocked orchestrator.

findings.summary: Reactive TASK_CREATED dispatch path lacks end-to-end test coverage
evidence: test_agent_graph.py covers GraphBuilder and unit orchestrator behavior but not app wiring of TaskDispatchService + ProducerService subscribers
findings.suggestion: Add an async integration test that emits TASK_CREATED and asserts claim_task plus run_workflow invocation through services.

findings.summary: LangChainAdapter invoke and generate duplicate identical event-loop bootstrap
evidence: invoke() and generate() each repeat get_event_loop/new_event_loop/run_until_complete blocks
findings.suggestion: Extract _run_sync(coro) helper used by both sync entry points.

findings.summary: AgentOrchestrator.__init__ uses mutable dict default for nodes parameter
evidence: __init__(..., nodes: dict[str, Any] = {}, ...) uses mutable default argument
findings.suggestion: Change default to None and assign nodes = nodes or {} inside __init__.

findings.summary: UI reads and writes project.json and tasks.json directly, violating AGENTS.md FileManager rule
evidence: main_window uses _read_project_json/_write_project_json with Path directly
kanban_board loads and saves tasks.json without FileManager
findings.suggestion: Route UI persistence through FileManager methods so agents and UI share one file contract and event stream.

findings.summary: Orchestrator builds full polling graph at startup but UI uses event-driven path only
evidence: AgentOrchestrator.__init__ compiles self.compiled_graph from full WorkflowSpec
MainWindow calls start_event_driven; run_polling_workflow and stream_workflow are unused from app/UI
findings.suggestion: Defer or skip full-graph compilation when operating in event-driven mode; compile only producer and per-task graphs needed at runtime.

findings.summary: Repeated unicode section banners and tutorial docstrings inflate comment-to-code ratio
evidence: Multiple modules use # ── Section ── banners and multi-paragraph docstrings on obvious factories
findings.suggestion: Remove decorative section banners and shorten docstrings to non-obvious behavior only.

findings.summary: app.py owns logging, tracing, agent wiring, workflow specs, and GUI bootstrap in one file
evidence: app.py (~390 LOC) combines setup_tracing, _create_agents, _setup_components, event subscriptions, and main()
findings.suggestion: Split into bootstrap.py (tracing/logging), composition.py (agent/workflow wiring), and keep app.py as a thin entrypoint.
